scenarios: device credential cannot enqueue administrator commands
real browser XHR polls and ACKs; lost ACK plus reconnect does not dispatch twice
other device denied; owner receives the unchanged Unicode command
unlisted browser origin is blocked by real CORS/preflight enforcement
expired queued commands are not dispatched after reconnect
unsupported platform dispatch is acknowledged as handled, not claimed executed
limitations: Real Chromium XHR, Go server, CORS, authentication, queues and ACK delivery.
Platform command dispatch and settings persistence callbacks are substitutes; no picture/audio or hardware volume confirmation.
Loopback HTTP and synthetic credentials only; production deployment and TLS not qualified.
